description: This file implements a generic fixed-size circular buffer (ring buffer) in Go, including methods for writing data, retrieving buffer contents, and managing buffer state.

classes.name: TypedRingFixed[T any]
classes.description: A generic fixed-size circular buffer for elements of type T, supporting write, reset, and data retrieval operations.

methods.name: NewTypedRingFixed
methods.description: Creates a new circular buffer with specified capacity.

methods.name: Write
methods.description: Writes a slice of elements into the buffer, overwriting old data if necessary.

methods.name: Slice
methods.description: Returns the buffer contents in write order without modifying the buffer.

methods.name: Size
methods.description: Returns the capacity of the buffer.

methods.name: Len
methods.description: Returns the current number of elements in the buffer.

methods.name: TotalWritten
methods.description: Returns the total number of elements ever written to the buffer.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Clears the buffer, resetting its state.
